title: Nobody Learns in a Crooked Room
subtitle: 品格修养 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 品格修养（做人与做事·优秀品行与道德品质）
meta: 主题语境：品格修养（做人与做事·优秀品行与道德品质）　|　核心词汇：respect　|　正文 358 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 respect 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: Mr Bai cleaned our school for thirty-one years. He was never late and never spoke about himself. We called him by his surname and nothing else, and few of us showed him much ① respect: cleaners are easy to overlook, particularly at sixteen. Respect, as he practised it, had nothing whatever to do with fear.

He had one habit I noticed early. Every evening he pushed the desks back into straight lines, exactly square with the blackboard. In that one ② respect his work was stricter than any teacher's, and when I asked him why he said something I did not understand at the time: 'Nobody learns in a crooked room.'

In my second year a group of boys broke four windows and blamed it on the wind. Mr Bai swept up the glass without a word and ③ respected something more important than the rules: he never reported anybody, never shouted, and never complained to the office.

He died suddenly that spring. Respected by people who had never once asked his name, he was buried on a wet Tuesday. At the assembly two hundred students stood in silence while our head teacher asked us to ④ pay our respects to a man most of us had looked straight through for three years.

I have thought about him since, and about that sentence I did not understand. Nobody learns in a crooked room: those straight desks were not tidiness but a quiet argument about how people should treat a place they share. I ⑤ respect that answer completely now. It also taught me that ⑥ respect costs nothing to give and is almost impossible to demand. The boys who broke those windows were never found out. Mr Bai knew exactly who they were and told nobody — ⑦ out of respect for something larger than the rules, I suppose, though he never used such a phrase. ⑧ In this respect he was stricter with himself than with any of us, and ⑨ with respect to the glass on the floor he said only one thing: that glass sweeps up more easily than blame. Nobody ever demanded ⑩ respect from that man, and everybody gave it to him anyway.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 尊敬；敬重（show/have respect for）
B. n. 尊重；顾及某个原则（out of respect for）
C. n. 方面；细节（in this/that respect）
D. v. 尊敬；敬重某人
E. v. 尊重；遵守（规则、事实、习俗）
F. 固定搭配：pay one's respects 表示敬意；致哀
G. 固定搭配：in this respect 在这一点上
H. 固定搭配：with respect to 关于；就……而言

items.q: In that one respect his work was stricter
respected something more important than the rules
asked us to pay our respects
out of respect for something larger than the rules
In this respect he was stricter with himself
with respect to the glass on the floor
Nobody ever demanded respect from that man

answers.why: show sb respect 意为“向某人表示尊敬”，此处说学生们很少尊敬他。
in that one respect 意为“在那一方面”，说明摆课桌这件事做得比任何老师都严格。
respect＋宾语 something more important，是动词“尊重”，指他守住比校规更要紧的东西。
pay one's respects 用于追悼、致意的场合，校长请大家向这位劳动者致敬。
respect＋宾语 that answer，是动词“敬服、认同”，作者如今完全认同那句回答。
作主语的 respect 是名词“尊敬”，说明尊敬无需付出却难以索取。
out of respect for＋抽象原则，意为“出于对……的尊重”，此处指出于对某种更高原则的顾及。
in this respect 意为“在这一点上”，与第 2 题同为“方面”义。
with respect to 意为“关于、就……而言”，引出他对地上玻璃的唯一评论。
demand respect from sb 中的 respect 是名词“尊敬”，说明他从未索取，却始终得到。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 我们那时很少向学校的清洁工表示尊敬。（respect n.）
在这一点上，他做得比任何老师都严格。（in this respect）
他从不告发任何人，因为他尊重比校规更重要的东西。（respect v.）
班主任请全体学生向这位劳动者致哀。（pay one's respects）
他这样做是出于对某种比规则更大的原则的尊重。（out of respect for）
关于地上的碎玻璃，他只说了一句很轻的话。（with respect to）
answers: We showed the school cleaner very little respect.
In this respect he was stricter than any teacher.
He never reported anybody, because he respected something more important than the school rules.
Our head teacher asked all the students to pay their respects to the worker.
He did it out of respect for something larger than the rules.
With respect to the broken glass on the floor, he said only one soft sentence.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 respect 的 3 种不同用法；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: For thirty-one years Mr Bai cleaned our school, and few students showed him much respect.
In this respect he was stricter than any teacher: every evening he squared the desks with the blackboard.
He respected something more important than the rules, and never reported anybody to the office.
When he died, our head teacher asked two hundred students to pay their respects in silence.
Out of respect for something he never named, he told nobody who had broken the windows.
Respect, I learned from him, costs nothing to give, is almost impossible to demand, and has nothing to do with fear.
